description: The true path of the miniature: a door locked at night and open in the morning, so someone unlocked and opened it between; what that act needed (a key, and being at the door) is set against what the timeline says of each man.

moves.why: Locked at ten, open at six: someone unlocked and opened it in between.

moves.see: there are two keys, and Ned has neither
moves.why: Unlocking needs a key, and there are only two.

moves.see: Ned was in the loft across the yard
moves.why: It needs a man at the door, and Ned was across the yard all night.
No key, and not at the door: the drink came to him some other way.

moves.see: Jem carries a key to the door
Jem lay all night in the passage
moves.why: And he lay all night in the passage the door opens off.
Everything the act needed, Jem had.
